Help.0: /invite (Character name): Invite another character to the conversation
Help.1: /whisper (Character name) : Send a whisper to a character who is participating in a conversation
Help.3: Shrink the Maple Chat for a compact view that only displays the conversation.
Help.4: You can give Likability to a different character.
Help.5: You can add characters who are not your friends to your friends list.
Help.6: You can report a different character using Report.
